name: LatentColorMatch via RGB colour-space conversions
plain: Runs kornia RGB→LAB or YCbCr or LUV or XYZ on the first three latent channels as if they were an image, without rescaling, then does mean/std transfer and converts back. Extra channels get a simpler match. Formally, RGB-to-LAB is defined for 0..1 images, so this treats latent values as out-of-range RGB.
math:
pseudoRGB=x[:,:3]; L=rgb_to_lab(pseudoRGB) (no 0..1 rescale)
matched=(L−μL)/σL·σR+μR with factor, back to RGB
x[:,3:] match_extra_channels
